d: As an Account Manager at Talabat, you will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with our restaurant and vendor partners. You will serve as the main point of contact, helping them optimize their presence on our platform, grow their sales, and ensure a high level of partner satisfaction.
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing restaurant and vendor partners.
Ensure high partner satisfaction and retention through proactive communication, support, and service excellence.
Serve as a trusted advisor, providing partners with insights that support their business growth on the platform.
Analyze sales, operational, and engagement data to identify areas for improvement in menu performance, pricing, promotions, and delivery logistics.
Share actionable recommendations based on performance metrics to drive revenue and efficiency.
Conduct regular business reviews to align on results, opportunities, and growth plans.
Identify growth opportunities within the portfolio – upsell services, suggest cross-promotions, and improve partner performance.
Support partners in optimizing content (e.g., menu structure, images, delivery times) for better customer engagement and conversion.
Recommend and coordinate marketing campaigns and promotional offers to drive order volume.
Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, and Operations to address partner needs and resolve issues promptly.
Ensure smooth onboarding, campaign execution, and issue resolution for assigned accounts.
Negotiate and renew commercial agreements to ensure a fair and strategic partnership.
Ensure partners comply with service-level agreements and maintain operational standards, including delivery quality and availability.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or Partner Success (experience in food tech, FMCG, or e-commerce is a plus).
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data dashboards and Excel/Google Sheets to analyze performance and generate insights.
*Must be living in or willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi*
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Customer-first mindset with a strong focus on delivering value to partners.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

d: Launched in Bahrain in November 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We're a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To function as the Kitchen Manager for the Calo Kitchen and work closely with the Head Chef to ensure all production sections operate successfully in accordance with company standards through an efficient, scalable, and modern style of kitchen management.

The Kitchen Manager will be responsible for overseeing daily kitchen production operations, ensuring the highest standards of food quality, safety, efficiency, and team performance while delivering operational excellence in a high-volume production environment.
q: Proven experience in large-scale food production operations with a focus on management roles within reputed international hotel groups, restaurant chains, airline catering, meal subscription businesses, cloud kitchens, or large catering operations.
Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field is preferred.
In-depth knowledge of Health & Safety, HACCP, ISO standards, and other relevant food safety regulations.

Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience within large-scale food production environments, including experience as a Sous Chef, Chef de Cuisine, Kitchen Manager, Production Manager, or similar leadership role.
Experience managing multicultural teams within fast-paced and high-volume production environments.
Experience managing kitchen operations serving large daily meal volumes is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of inventory management, cost control, and production planning principles.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rapidly scaling production environment.
Strong knowledge of various cooking methods, ingredients, and production processes.
Strong understanding of food safety systems and quality assurance practices.
Excellent leadership and people management capabilities.
Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of food cost and operational efficiency drivers.
Familiarity with ERP systems, inventory management systems, and production reporting tools.
Excellent time management and prioritization skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards.
Ability to make decisions quickly and effectively under pressure.
Strong communicator with the ability to influence and engage teams at all levels.
Pleasant personality with the ability to lead, coach, and develop team members with empathy and patience.
Hands-on leader who leads by example and drives accountability.
Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
Passionate about food, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
